profile.name: 是德科技 MSO-X/DSO-X 3000A 系列示波器
profile.description: 台式数字/混合信号示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电信号波形。它常用于实验室中的电路调试、时序分析、脉冲与频率测量、上升下降时间评估、占空比分析以及屏幕截图、波形导出和仪器设置保存。
profile.description_en: A benchtop digital or mixed-signal oscilloscope used to capture, display, and analyze electrical waveforms. It is commonly used in laboratories for circuit debugging, timing analysis, pulse and frequency measurements, rise/fall time evaluation, duty-cycle analysis, as well as saving screenshots, exporting waveform data, and storing instrument setups.
